versions.content: Behavior on failed target identification If the config- ured mode rule referenced by DcmDspAuthenticationTargetIdentification- ModeRuleRef is evaluated to fail, the Dcm shall refuse the certificate and send a negative response with NRC 'Certificate verification failed - Invalid Scope'.
